# Lintel Docs Unmoderated Test 2026-08-24

Launch of the unmoderated test of Lintel Kit's getting-started page, the second Marrowgate assignment. Eight participants, each with a week to complete it.

## Setup

- Three tasks: install the kit into a new Figma file, change the brand color token and see it applied to a button, find the guidance on text colors.
- Participants P1 to P8: designers who had not bought the kit, recruited through the circle and the Design Night list. Screen and voice recorded through the testing tool; a $40 gift card each, $320 total.
- Ended with the [[system-usability-scale|SUS]] questionnaire, out of habit, though the page is documentation, not an interface.

## What went wrong at launch

I skipped the pilot [[lorna-beckett|Lorna]] recommended. Task 3 said "Find the color guidance page", and there was no page by that name; it was a section. P1 and P2 spent most of their time on it. I reworded the task on 2026-08-25 and kept their other tasks.

Results in [[lintel-docs-unmoderated-test-results]].
